deadline_text_verbatim: You must submit your application by 30th June 2026. [...] Please note that these deadlines are indicative and are intended to encourage candidates to submit their application as early as possible once eligibility has been confirmed. The Universitaly portal remains open.
researcher_notes: Universitaly pre-enrolment deadline -- identical date (30 June 2026) to the one found independently at Sapienza University of Rome, suggesting a shared national deadline (likely MUR-set) rather than coincidental agreement between two universities. Notably softer framing than France's DAP 'delai de rigueur': explicitly called 'indicative' with the portal said to remain open past the stated date, a genuine difference from the French strict-deadline framing worth preserving rather than normalizing away. Closed as of retrieval (2026-08-21).
